name: PT BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk provides investment, working capital, multipurpose, and other financing services primarily in Indonesia. The company operates through Cars, Motorcycles, and Others segments. It provides collateral financing house; collateral financing vehicle car; collateral financing vehicle motorcycle; used car loans; heavy equipment and industrial machinery procurement; and sharia financing services. The company was formerly known as PT Bunas Finance Indonesia Tbk and changed its name to PT BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk in June 2001. PT BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Tangerang Selatan, Indonesia.
